-- this theorem might be useful in the proof of the problem
theorem exists_deriv_eq_zero {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
  (hab : a < b) (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (hfI : f a = f b) :
  ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, deriv f c = 0

-- here's an example of theorem exists_deriv_eq_zero being used
example (p : ℝ[X]) :
    p.roots.toFinset.card ≤ (p.derivative.roots.toFinset \ p.roots.toFinset).card + 1 := by
  rcases eq_or_ne (derivative p) 0 with hp' | hp'
  · rw [eq_C_of_derivative_eq_zero hp', roots_C, Multiset.toFinset_zero, Finset.card_empty]
    exact zero_le _
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_apply_ne derivative (by rwa [derivative_zero])
  refine Finset.card_le_diff_of_interleaved fun x hx y hy hxy hxy' => ?_
  rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_roots hp] at hx hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_zero hxy p.continuousOn (hx.trans hy.symm)
  refine ⟨z, ?_, hz1⟩
  rwa [Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_roots hp', IsRoot, ← p.deriv]

-- this theorem might be useful in the proof of the problem
theorem ContinuousOn.mono {f : α → β} {s t : Set α}
  (hf : ContinuousOn f s) (h : t ⊆ s) : ContinuousOn f t

-- here's an example of theorem ContinuousOn.mono being used
example {r : ℝ} {s : Set ℝ≥0} (h : 0 ∉ s ∨ 0 ≤ r) :
    ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ≥0 => z ^ r) s := by
  refine h.elim ?_ ?_
  · intro hs
    exact ContinuousOn.mono (s := {0}ᶜ) (by fun_prop) (by aesop)
  · intro hr
    exact (NNReal.continuous_rpow_const hr).continuousOn

-- this theorem might be useful in the proof of the problem
theorem Set.Icc_subset_Icc {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : α} (h₁ : a₂ ≤ a₁) (h₂ : b₁ ≤ b₂) :
  Set.Icc a₁ b₁ ⊆ Set.Icc a₂ b₂

-- here's an example of theorem Set.Icc_subset_Icc being used
example [Lattice α] {a b : α} : Set.Icc a b ⊆ Set.uIcc a b := by
  exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc inf_le_left le_sup_right

-- this theorem might be useful in the proof of the problem
theorem lt_or_gt_of_ne {a b : α} (h : a ≠ b) : a < b ∨ a > b

-- here's an example of theorem lt_or_gt_of_ne being used
example (α : Type*) [Nontrivial α] [LinearOrder α] : ∃ x y : α, x < y := by
  rcases exists_pair_ne α with ⟨x, y, hxy⟩
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hxy with hxy_lt | hxy_gt
  · exact ⟨x, y, hxy_lt⟩
  · exact ⟨y, x, hxy_gt⟩
